record.what_it_does: Fathom is an AI meeting recorder/notetaker that records video calls and produces transcripts, summaries, and action items.
record.auth_notes: API key (X-Api-Key header) is generated per-user in Settings and is meant for internal/single-tenant tools; OAuth2 (Bearer token) is documented as the method for public apps that other Fathom users install to connect their own accounts. OAuth-connected apps have a functional restriction: they can't use include_summary/include_transcript on /meetings and must call the /recordings endpoints instead.
record.access_notes: Confirmed on the official FAQ: 'API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans,' including the Free plan, with no per-call charges. Anyone can generate an API key immediately in User Settings. Building a public OAuth app additionally requires registering the app, and OAuth apps are 'subject to review' if seeking marketplace promotion, but base API/OAuth credential issuance itself is not gated by a paid plan.
record.main_blocker: Small surface (~10 endpoints: meetings, meeting types, recording summary/transcript/download, teams, team members, users, webhooks) and OAuth apps face review before public/marketplace distribution
